one_liner: Google's online advertising platform; the API lets developers manage campaigns, reporting, and billing programmatically.

auth.evidence_quote: Google Ads API also uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication and authorization. OAuth 2.0 enables your Google Ads API client app to access a user's Google Ads account without having to handle or store the user's login info.
auth.notes: A separate developer token is required in addition to OAuth2 credentials, per same page: 'In addition to the OAuth 2.0 credentials, you also need a developer token to make API calls.'

access.evidence_quote: In addition to the OAuth 2.0 credentials, you also need a developer token to make API calls.
access.notes: Developer tokens start with test-account-only access; Basic/Standard production access requires Google approval. Google Ads test accounts are free.

api.evidence_quote: Google Ads API also uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication and authorization.
api.notes: Did not check specifically for an official Google Ads MCP server within the call budget; API surface (GAQL resources, services) is very large, well over 100 endpoints/resources.

verdict.rationale: OAuth2 plus a free developer token gives immediate test-account access, but production use on arbitrary accounts requires Google approval of the developer token.
